title.en: A gift for our young Tandara families

message.hr: Ovaj dar vrijedi od 25. listopada 2026. do kraja mojeg života, za obitelji prezimena Tandara kojima se u tom razdoblju rodi peto dijete. Ne odnosi se na obitelji koje su peto dijete dobile prije 25. listopada 2026.
message.en: This gift applies from 25 October 2026 until the end of my life, to families bearing the Tandara name whose fifth child is born during that period. It does not apply to families whose fifth child was born before 25 October 2026.

imageAlt.hr: Poruka Jure Tandare: dar od 500 eura obitelji prezimena Tandara koja dobije peto dijete.
imageAlt.en: Message from Jure Tandara: a gift of €500 to a family bearing the Tandara name that welcomes its fifth child.
